\[
M_{L=3,\ \theta=0^{\circ}} = \begin{bmatrix}
  0 & 0 & 0 \\
  0.3333 & 0.3333 & 0.3333 \\
  0 & 0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\]

With length 3 and angle 0 the kernel is a row of three equal weights. For the pixel with value 90, between 60 and 150, the result is (60 + 90 + 150) / 3 = 100.
